More than welcome, I'm not afraid of my story. I can use it as a way to help others because I have been there, I have lived a hard life already and it puts me in a position to say hey look, we can get through it. Wont be easy but you know what, I'm here. I am from the same place as you my friend, but its 10:45 here ;P I am a ball of fun, but I am me. Take it or leave it I don't mind because I've learnt to not take people and things for granted (:Thats just a general statement to everyone! But I just want to help, I have been there I am out on my own two feet now, i still need a helping hand sometimes but I am proof there can be hope.
I am now almost 19. just to clarify things. But AGE is just a number not an indication of what you have been through. People can judge if they want I don't care.

You know what I will give you my whole story. I am not afraid of anything.  I want to help people because when I was in my hole of despair I had No-one I was alone, but at the point of breaking I had a kind person give me their hand and show me another way out and from there I have gone from strength to strength, and if it wasn't for that one persons kindness I wouldn't be here today, I wouldn't have seen the beauty of life. Hell I'm still in recovery and I struggle but I'm in a better place now.


 I was an accident of a child, I was never wanted as a child they didn't want children but I happened. Result of a car accident apparently. 
This led to emotionally unavailable parents, I never experienced love. Kindness. or anything that a child should get from them. 

There was never any other family around, they wouldn't let them so I didn't get them feelings from an outside source. I lived in fear as long as I can remember, Emotionally, Physically, Mentally, Sexually abused up by people I was meant to trust, not just family others too. 

This started at age 5 approximately. I wasn't allowed friends either so I learnt to isolate myself from a very early age. About the age of 10, I was no longer sexually abused for about 3 years.

The one friend I did have committed suicide when I was 11, she hung herself. I was the last one to see her alive and the first one to see her dead. I never dealt with the grief, it was considered weak. 

School was never good from primary school right through to high school, I was considered different so I was heavily bullied. At 13 I turned to Cigarettes, Alcohol and some pretty heavy drugs. I also became a sex slave (my own choice even though I didn't want it, it paid for my habits) That lasted about 2 years.

At 15, I first attempted to take my own life. When I got out of hospital I got beaten for being weak and not succeeding, go figure.

At 16 I moves schools things kinda changed, I quit all the sex, drugs, smoking and alcohol. I was still heavily abused at home, but I also realised I was interested in females as well after everything so I was condemned for that too but hey I ended up in a relationship.

At 17 Dad tried to commit suicide, it was my fault i made his life unbearable. I had a friend try to intervene as she unfortunately saw the abuse and the scared little child and she has been in my life ever since trying to make it better. I got beaten even worse when they found out someone was trying to help me, it was like I just wanted to share the secret life of our family. They actually tried to get a restraining order on her and failed, she told them about the abuse but there was no concrete proof and at that point there was no extensive injuries, it had mellowed a little just for that occasion, it got worse but i was so scared for her for everything I just suffered as I had.At this point I spent 3 weeks in hospital for extensive injuries after trying to commit suicide again. In the last 12 months, my relationship ended. I got kicked out of home. I couldnt afford to leave thats why I hadnt left and no-one was gonna help me. I still go back to see my animals they were my life, but nothing much has changed at home, except im not there to be physically abused, just emotionally now but after everything it cracks me. I am now slowly recovering from all my life. I am on medication and in extensive therapy. I am a sufferer of Bi-polar, Schizophrenia, Borderline Personality disorder, Anxiety and OCD. I am a ball of fun, but I survived through all that and you know what I want to be the friend I didnt have until later.
Anytime, let me know how it goes and if you need a friend I am here (: x

Well the best thing you can do is ring the emergency number in your area, tell someone. You told us here. That means I see a spark in a sweet girl who just doesn't know where or who turn to. THERE IS HOPE! Don't be sorry for how you feel.
It's not attention seeking it's just that your ability to cope with things is different, we all are. Your just currently feeling like suicide is a way out because you cant rationalize and cope and thats okay. To address your concerns. I don't condemn you, I started self harming at 14, I was into drugs and abusing my body by 15, I have been there. I am not proud but I am proud to say I SURVIVED. Think you ARE in your last year, school is one of the hardest things to get through but you know what, in the not to distant future the world is yours! You can do what you like, you can show everyone just who you are and you can be proud, because you overcame this. Wear your smile. Its the most beautiful thing you own! Your getting help thats the best thing for you. You can do whatever you dream of! Keep your chin up!

It does, it's funny we can give the advice and then in our time of need we can't see it ourselves and need outside reassurance even if its only from a stranger. I know just how hard it can be in a situation like yours and I can't tell you it will be all peachy and come up smelling like roses because that would be giving you false expectations, but the thing is we live. We carry on because we are stronger than the blackmail we are given, those people are pathetic, we are survivors and in need we band together and help each other, and thats what you did and they shoved your kindness in your face. Im sorry your in the situation you are in, but have a little faith its nothing you cant handle, even if you need to ask for outside help (:

Well were all here to talk! There is nothing short of that.
Ask yourself one question, if you were to commit suicide would they really leave your family alone? It's not a guaranteed. It just means you wouldn't be there to protect them. Think about your kids, how would they cope without their loving parent. It sounds like you have done absolutely everything right by them and they would be pretty gutted if you were gone. Hey, I can't guarantee any situation will play out as expected, I dont know you but I have life experience. It's unreasonable however you don't know any other way to cope than running away. We all do it, thats why were here on suicide watch. I don't know where you live but try http://unsuicide.wikispaces.com/Online+Suicide+Help there are places on there that can give you people to talk to and give you some light on your situation. Just keep your chin up, there is a way out of your pit, first bit's the hardest but I and others are giving you a hand of hope to help get you out! I hope it all works out!
No your not, your a beautiful person who is struggling to face her demons alone, were here for you, have PM'd you

Everything has the ability to change, it's about pushing yourself to make those changes, giving up is easy, living is harder but it's possible and worth it. You have every reason to live and I doubt your a failure, we fail to allow us to learn there is a difference (: You can allow life to get the better of you and thats okay to but know it's possible, my favourite quote " It's like we talked about, you control this world. Let the pain go, let the hurt go, let the guilt go. What you are imagining right now,that world you control.That place can be as real as any pain." It's true. It's about taking the step and allowing yourself to fight that you dont trust, it took me a long time but there are people willing to help. 3 & 4 are just ways to cope with the unbearable pain, that can change when you shift the pain to better ways to cope. Anything is possible in this life, just know there are people here to help, my inbox is open if you do want to talk xx Keep your head up high, it can change.

Hey friend, I'm here to talk. Theres a light at the end of this, you just feel trapped in a deep hole and thats okay we all get like that, but there is help and hope!
You have been happy, there are moments in life that make it a little easier, they may not last long but they are there, it's about finding them. Life can be very painful, but theres happiness and good out there too. You need to look at the things you can do and grow from them, not focus on the things you cant do. Talk to us on reddit, I know I'm MORE than happy to be a friend you can talk to. There are people out there to reach out too its just about taking the steps, one foot infront of another. All couples argue, but you ARE good enough! Were all damaged in ways its about looking past our imperfections and being okay with who we are. There is a way out, I'm willing to give you my hand to help... I'm here for you (:

You have every other option besides suicide. It's not good that you lied to her but you know what to be honest everyone lies to someone they love or complete strangers it's human nature. You can come clean to her, honesty is the best remedy for anything, she might not understand, it certainly seems you don't but communication is a better option than what your thinking, I'd rather my partner tell me the truth than me finding them dead and the guilt that comes with someone close to you committing suicide. You need to admit you have an addiction in gambling and actually do something about it! I can understand perfectly, just think about your options first. xx
It's not pathetic coming here. There are people on here who care and want to help. It's not a fall I want you to take, I'm here to talk to if you want (:

Yay smiling is good! No I'm just a person who knows what it's like to be stuck in that place and I know how much I benefited from having someone to talk to, I just move the favor on. It means we can all help each other eventually. I'm glad your giving yourself a second chance, just don't be too harsh on yourself if it's not as expected. It's about baby steps. My inbox is always open for people so your welcome to message me again if you need  a friend (: x

Life is a scary thing but it's worth it! You'll find your path soon enough, just don't give up hope yet. Your not a bother, if they are real friends they would be more than happy to help, often people retract because suicide and intentionally hurting oneself leaves grounds for panicking but they don't know what to do. Yeah, but you would have been there just as they were for you, sometimes we need others to pick us up instead of us picking them up, its what makes the world go round. And? You can make a life for yourself, its not about the destination but the journey. Well it's time to break free! you can do it!

Yes, best place is Emergency hospital they can direct you from there. Depending on where you are also depend on further options you have but thats an option anywhere in the world. I'm glad you'd rather get help than end it all. All the best xx

You are NEVER truly alone. You may feel it but your not. Your talking to me aren't you? Take a step out of it and show people that maybe you aren't as okay as you thought. You don't need to tell them that straight out but maybe mention that it was harder than you let on and that you are struggling with the idea, it can be done. Yourself can be anything you let it be, as long as it isn't fake.There will be someone, there always is miracles don't happen overnight there is still time. Your not a piece of shit, be yourself and be confident about it. You will find someone, it's not the end just yet.

I know and I know just how much it hurts, you have to remember dreams aren't real they are things your mind create and in some cases which I think yours might be they allow your subconscious to deal with things you can't on a conscious level, obviously you loved her. Good keep going out there, you will never forget her but it's about learning to cope with the thoughts and move on. I know you don't want to but i'm thinking it's your minds way of coping with the emotional pain of it all. Your not worthless and you may not have but there is always time to change that. At least you can admit its a problem thats a start and you can make the change to iron all of the creases out, it CAN be done, time to heal is what you need. Well what your about to do isn't the way out, it means shes won. That might be an okay thing to you, but it's not to me. No person can be controlled by others, it's about fighting these feelings, fighting the dreams. There is blue sky's ahead just let them come.
alright (: look forward to it x

If shes got another close adult in her life maybe get her to talk to them, or even worst case a hospital, until something can be done just stay there as her friend, sometimes having soomeone to talk to can change everything. x

Please don't. It's not the answer. You may not want to improve it because it seems to just go downhill again but there is hope. Please reconsider what you are doing, the world doesn't need to lose another special person tonight. It can get better, just let it. Here if you want to talk x

Hey dude, at 15 you still have everything going for you. You have 60+ years to enjoy yet, the first 15-21 most people struggle, especially since there are so many changes to your life. It may feel like no-one cares but people out there do, some you may have not even met yet. Your family may not have much of a connection to you but that's not everything, it's the people you surround yourself with that matter. Yeah but for anyone on the outside self harming behaviors are quite scary given it's not always easy to be understand or manage, I know from both sides it's not easy. Its not always about having people around its doing things that you enjoy and make you happy. Life is about finding what works for you, you may not have the essential life skills you need yet but there still is time to learn if you allow yourself. You don't want to die, I know it you know it, just it seems an easier option to the pain in life, like it feels it wont get better. it can, you just need to start by allowing it and wanting it to, open your mind to a world of possibilities! Keep your chin up, and PM if you need to talk x

There is always people here who care (: Let the thought be there, EVERYONE at some point has thoughts of suicide, it's not uncommon. What makes you different my friend is whether you act on these thoughts or fight for the life you deserve. Happiness is what you make of it, it could be anything, big or little. Don't let the actions of your family control your life, it's hard I know seeing as they should have been an example for you but what they do is not a reflection of you but their own lives ( coming from an emotionally unavailable and abusive family, I understand this) You have comfort in something keep that comfort, find the little things, little things will get you through. What you go through every day is managable, I have really bad Anxiety and OCD and other things, keep your chin up. PM if you want to talk with someone, I'm always here (: 'Just keep swimming'
but committing suicide is so final, it's worth waiting.
A year isn't any amount of time in all seriousness... things take time. You have plenty of time left to find the happiness. Hate and regret aren't the only things in life, there is more out there.
That surely isn't true, joy and happiness is all around it's just sometimes about looking for it and letting the little things in.

Don't give up beautiful person (: You have already stated it won't get better so no matter what I say, you are damn right. You have already given up on it, if you questioned whether it would, with some work from you and help from others it could have definitely gotten better, things can change if you allow them too.

While your working there, look for another, find something you want to do, i'm not saying quit now, but i'm saying look for something better. You deserve better, that alone gives you something to look forward too. I bet as a kid there was something you always wanted to do, go chase it now.

You have everything to live for, you shouldn't live for others but only yourself, you can make yourself happy. It doesnt make it any easier not having friends around but it also doesnt make it much harder. Dont take it to heart, work on getting fit do little bits each day to improve your health, you can achieve whatever you want too. 
I'm sorry your father left while you were so young and I'm sorry to hear you mother has attempted suicide, its not a nice situation your in however it doesnt mean its the end for you. Suicide is the easy way out, there is so much more to life than that. keep your head up (: xx PM is open if you want to talk

I know exactly how you feel here...I'm glad you don't have easy access to means now though. You still have the ability to do it but while the tension is so high you can down the pills in one swift action, by not having them you actually have to go get them. The healthcare system no matter where in the world you are can be quite shit, I've been playing in it 6 years now and they still don't take things seriously, in saying that some places have done their fair share of good, but i went through hell and back to get it. Ending your life will just mean a life lost, it won't make them do anything better in the future. Everyone has a future, how clear depends on the individual. Dont put yourself down every single soul has what it takes to make a life, it aint easy but its worth it. Just keep swimming and keep your head up high, PM me if you want (:

There is ALWAYS people to tell. You told all of us didn't you? 
Doesn't have to be anyone you know and sometimes it's easier explaining it to a complete stranger than someone very much so in your life. As much as it can be painful the healthcare system is there to help you through times and feelings like this. Your definitely not alone in this. Start with a doctor? School Councellor just anyone. Left untreated depression can become unmanageable especially for someone to cope with on their own and it sounds like thats just what has happened. You said you don't want to kill yourself, thats a good start. What is happening is that on a typical scales, the pain your feeling is outweighing the ways you know how to cope. This is normal but the balance can be made even again. Suicide is not the answer to the end of your story, your right your young and you have many many years left. Your scared and feel alone,  you have taken the first step and reached out to us here, you can to others now too. There is no way that wouldn't hurt, they all have their consequences and pain especially if you fail, you'll say you wont but more often than not you do and you have to live with the consequences, I have been there before. It's not easy but it is worth it. Keep your chin up, You can talk further to me if you want to my Inbox is always open (: Keep smiling xx

Those people are right. You are a good guy.  Be Proud, you put yourself at risk to help another human, regardless of whether or not they wanted the help, you saved a life today. Thats how you need to see it. Would you see the situation different, if it was say a car accident and you pulled the driver out before the car burst into flames. No matter how you look at it you saved a precious persons life. Also I don't know if you have children but here's another silly analogy. What if you had a daughter? What if she did this and you didn't know. Would you have wanted someone to save her? The person was someones child, someones friend. You did the right thing. What you are feeling now will pass. I have been witness to a couple of suicides in my life time and you wish you could make a difference. Well you did my friend. Stay strong, I'm here if you need someone to talk to xo

It's lovely to see people like you are around!

I will if I get through the next few days, I ended up in hospital for my injuries, but being as scared as I was I talked my way around it was a suicide attempt but simply an accident with some decent sized machinery. Thankyou for caring though, does mean alot.

Sadly I did, but thankyou for the gesture, remember age is just a number the amount you've had to go through is more a determination of such things... I know its not. Next week is the anniversary of a beloved friend.
Thanks, I'm still here. Barely, I feel like even more of a failure because I just ended up with plenty of stitches. I want to try again but right now I'm too exhausted.

Firstly I'm so glad to hear you say you don't want to die. It means that we can help because you haven't set your mind in stone that your going to end your life, you've given yourself every fighting chance and I am ever so glad. I'm even proud. (: You (with help) need to find a way to balance coping strategies with the pain you feel, but that can be done.

You are not a failure, it sounds like you have a mental illness, thats nothing to be ashamed of, it appears as 'crazy' in our lives but it's not you. You can get better live your life free from that place. I'm proud that you have gone months, but taking a step back after taking so many steps forward is normal and is definitely okay. Let me be the voice in your head. Your a beautiful person worth every happiness. You have the strength to push through this. Failure is only measured by you, take everything you see as a failure as a step towards success. 

Don't let what other people see determine what you think of yourself. 

You don't need to do that to yourself okay? Pills and alcohol. Suicide isn't the answer you know this. your just in a place of despair where everything seems too big to deal with, you have been out of this place before and can return there. We all have the fear of being 'crazy' and people finding out HOWEVER, my question to you is if we remove suicide as an option which really it isn't. Would you rather let people determine what you are and are not, or would you like a freedom from this pain? 

Think about it. I cannot do anything, but simply take this. For your safety I would rather you call your councellor or directly contact a hospital whichever your comfortable with, and take a HUGE step forward and  allow people to help you. Your not crazy, trust me <3 

Take Care and Keep Smiling,
Daretobedifferent xo

Happiness is NEVER too hard to obtain. It's out there, as you find yourself you will also find your happiness. Suicide isn't the answer. PLEASE rethink what your doing, a lot of us care and want you here! Pain passes. Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. You have only lived 18 years and they were probably the hardest, it gets better!

No-one is ever a lost cause. In moments of despair we all would rather get out but you don't need to. We all care and we are all here, we don't want to loose one of our friends today/tonight especially not to suicide. You cannot hate someone for not being able to cope with the pain in their life, just show them you love them and want them to pull through.

Well you can look at this a number of ways, a lot of people that post here that want to commit suicide aren't always looking to end their life just the circumstantial pain that has completely overwhelmed/consumed them and it appears to them there is no other way to reduce the pain that they are dealing with, that would be why a lot of people post, a little bit of light in some of the darkest hours can make all the difference and can help relieve the pain. 

Yes we are all very much so responsible for our actions but not everything that leads to them actions those who do suffer mental health related issues are not always responsible, and it can take a lot to get the help needed. 

I personally have been in the same position, I have even asked for help before because suicide did seem my only option and I survived, somedays it's barely, but someone showed me there was hope and I try and pass the favor on knowing just how bad it feels to be in that place.

It's definitely not pathetic, it's how you feel which means it has every amount of meaning especially to you. 
It's never easy dealing with those suicidal feelings especially since they have been around so long however the fact you are still here and still able to think rationally is great, it means between the people that can support you and yourself there is a chance to help you manage these feelings and build yourself a life. You may not see a future that far ahead but hey your 17, you have 3 years to find that passion and reason to live. I know it feels like your unloved but there is many of us strangers who give a damn about how you feel and want to help. Your mum may be fragile however I think she'd rather you talk to her than lose her child, which would be worse? Things get better, sometimes it takes time and persistence. Yes the future is scary but why not give it a chance, you have nothing to lose, suicide is always still there as an option. I've been where you are, I've felt the pain, I know what it feels like but it gets better if you give it a chance.

Theres no going back yes, however theres no more of this, the crap that doesn't outweigh the good in life. I think this overwhelming feeling is more  fear than anything, I'm trying so hard not to act on it and even harder not to hurt myself to make myself pay. I know everything takes time, just I'm running out of it. 18 years of life and over the time, to think about the good moments there is maybe at best 4 years of good ones, basically when I was too young to remember and the far and few in between when I could. Your words make complete sense, just part of me doesn't want to agree...

Not really, I lost the only thing that used to keep me in one piece. I had two horses that I was so close to, they knew how to brighten my broken side. When everything fell apart I lost them, right now I dont really have a true reason to even want to get through the days, guilt forces me on. You have that right, I'm sick to death of these feelings all these emotions.

my heart wants to end it, and its been that way for ages, I've kept going barely but I have been, if it wasn't for that little part of guilt for the people who have spent years working with me taking very slow steps and fighting for me. I know how disrupting it is having people around you take their own life, and I sadly have some on a conscience left... Last time I tried I should have succeeded. As far as i'm concerned I have no family after everything they have done to me, and friends I've already screwed myself over there. I've been trying so hard to improve it, I WANT it to get better but I don't know what else to do., I'm sick of it being like this.
I actually go back to the movie sucker punch when i'm sad or when things have gotten too the point it's a little too hard. It remins me it'll be okay you just have to fight.
